footerNote: TransitNow Logistics Services provides dispatch support services for independent couriers and box-truck operators in Milwaukee, WI. We do not offer loads or jobs ourselves, and we do not guarantee work, loads, revenue, earnings, rates, mileage, or broker approval.
privacyNoteHtml:
What we track:

  • Pages viewed on this site, so we can see which pages people find useful.
  • Lead source — if you arrived from a link with a source or campaign code, we record it so we know which outreach efforts work.
  • Checkout and purchase events — when you start checkout or complete a purchase, so we can follow up and provide service.

First-party only. Tracking is done by our own site for our own business purposes. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it with advertisers or data brokers.

Your choices: You can request a copy of the information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it — email us at transitnowservices@gmail.com. Unsubscribe from marketing emails anytime with the link at the bottom of any email.
